note: Canonical model dataset for resources.html. null means the lab has published nothing this dataset could verify; "unverified": true means the model is announced but carries no scores on file. SOURCING CAVEAT: the primary leaderboards (arcprize.org, epoch.ai, artificialanalysis.ai, llm-stats.com) are blocked by the network egress policy of the environment that assembled this file, so figures were taken from public trackers reached through search rather than read off the source. Treat the ranking as reliable and the decimals as approximate; corrections via pull request, with a link to the primary result.
benchmark_generation_note: ARC-AGI-2 and SWE-bench Verified both saturated during 2026 — frontier models moved from the teens to 90+ on ARC-AGI-2, and above 95 per cent on SWE-bench Verified. ARC-AGI-3 (interactive) and SWE-bench Pro replaced them. GPQA Diamond was dropped from this table for the same reason, having topped out around 92. HLE is recorded with tools enabled, from the comparison published alongside Claude Opus 5.5.

arc2.name: ARC-AGI-2
arc2.what: Abstract visual reasoning; saturated in 2026, retained to show the jump

arc3.name: ARC-AGI-3
arc3.what: Interactive reasoning — the model is given an unseen game and must infer the rules

swe.name: SWE-bench Pro
swe.what: Harder successor to SWE-bench Verified: patches that make real test suites pass

hle.name: Humanity's Last Exam (with tools)
hle.what: Expert-written questions built to resist saturation; tools-enabled runs only

cost.unit: USD per million tokens, list API price
cost.blend: blended_cost = (3 x input + output) / 4, following Artificial Analysis. Where only a single blended figure was published, it is recorded as "blended" directly.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Leads SWE-bench Pro and tools-enabled HLE while pricing 20 per cent under Opus 5; cache reads about $0.20/M. No ARC, SWE-bench Verified or GPQA figure reported.

models.name: GPT-6 “Astra”
models.note: Tops both ARC-AGI boards. OpenAI published no SWE-bench Pro score; reports DeepSWE v1.1 74 +/-3 and FrontierMath Tier 4 98 instead. Trails every Claude 5 model on HLE with tools.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: One tracker lists HLE with tools at 65.0; 65.6 is the figure in the Opus 5.5 launch comparison and is used here for consistency.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.price_note: Promotional rate through at least 21 November 2026; some sources quote $5/$30 as the standard rate.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Max

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.price_note: Sources conflict: one says the introductory $2/$10 rate became permanent on 11 August 2026, another that it moved to $3/$15 from September. $2/$10 used here.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.price_note: Promotional through 31 December 2026; doubles to $1.50/$7.50 on 1 January 2027. Also reports Terminal-Bench 2.1 89.4, narrowly ahead of Opus 5.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.note: Still Google's Pro flagship: Gemini 3.5 Pro was announced in May 2026 and has been delayed indefinitely.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.reports_elsewhere: Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.2; leads open weights on GDPval-AA v2 (1769). No ARC or SWE-bench Pro figure found.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.reports_elsewhere: Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.3; GDPval-AA v2 1682; wins DeepSWE 1.1 and FrontierSWE. Weights on Hugging Face since 27 July 2026. No ARC or SWE-bench Pro figure found.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.reports_elsewhere: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 46. No ARC, SWE-bench Pro or HLE figure found.

hle_note: The hle field holds tools-enabled Humanity's Last Exam runs only, taken from the comparison published with Claude Opus 5.5 so the top of the column shares one condition. Labs also report no-tools runs, which sit ten or more points lower; those are kept in hle_no_tools and never mixed into hle.

context.swe_bench_verified_retired: Frontier models cleared SWE-bench Verified above 95 per cent during 2026 (Claude Opus 5 around 96-97), clustering the leaders within a point. OpenAI stopped reporting Verified and now points to SWE-bench Pro.
context.open_weight_crossover: Four open-weight models now clear the vendor SWE-bench Pro figure reported for GPT-5.5 (58.6), putting open weights roughly one generation, not one era, behind the closed frontier.
context.price_direction: Capability per dollar is improving on both sides of the licence line. Opus 5.5 landed 10.7 points above Opus 5 on SWE-bench Pro at 20 per cent lower token prices, and open-weight prices fell across the board during 2026 (GLM-5.2 3.00 to 2.40, DeepSeek V4 Pro-Max 3.20 to 2.60, MiniMax M3 1.20 to 1.10).
context.google_pro_gap: Gemini 3.5 Pro was announced in May 2026 and has not shipped, so Gemini 3.1 Pro (February) remains Google's Pro flagship while three Flash releases in six weeks carried its progress. Gemini 3.8 Flash matches or beats 3.1 Pro on SWE-bench Pro at a third of the price.
